final: WITH group_sums AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) as group_sum FROM income GROUP BY link_to_member), stats AS (SELECT SUM(group_sum) as total_sum, COUNT(*) as num_groups FROM group_sums), shares AS (SELECT group_sum, CAST(group_sum AS REAL) / (SELECT total_sum FROM stats) as share FROM group_sums), avg_share AS (SELECT CAST(1.0 AS REAL) / num_groups as value FROM stats), filtered AS (SELECT group_sum, share FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT value FROM avg_share)) SELECT SUM(group_sum) as total_of_summed_amounts, AVG(share) as average_of_shares, AVG(share - (SELECT value FROM avg_share)) as average_of_share_minus_avg
